_comment: THE USER'S SEED-10 TURN 6 (USER 2026-10-20, viewer: 'This should be possible to win, but it misuses the mana').
Four Forests, Elvish Harbinger, a non-sick Accomplished Alchemist and Seedcradle Witch; hand Stroke of Genius +
Brindle Boar; opponent at 16. Cast Brindle Boar, sacrifice it (gain 4): X = 4 against the Witch's {2}{G}{W} is
mana-NEUTRAL, but every untap is +3/+3 on the Alchemist -- five untaps (alternating green / white taps, the
spare Forest + Harbinger floating the second colour) make it 17 power, and it attacks untapped for the kill.
VIEWER, the USER's own clicks: the Boar already cast and sacrificed (life gained 4, three Forests tapped),
then 'Seedcradle Witch: untap Accomplished Alchemist (+3/+3)' one activation at a time. With the colour-smart
payer (MTG_UNTAP_PAY_SMART) each tap floats the pip the untap lacks and generic comes out of the surplus colour,
so all five activations pay and the Alchemist attacks for 17. (Before: the fixed white tap stranded the green.)
